usage.finalMessage:
I added the `reminders <date>` command, using the 48-hour rule now in force (DEC-C08). The existing `reminder` command now also uses 48 hours, so I updated its test. `dotnet test` passes (10 of 10) and the work is committed (3dc9538).
DEC-W-4 was rejected, so no order is set for appointments at the same time. They come out in id order only as a side effect of how the data is stored. This is an open question in `.work/report.json`, along with the README's command list missing `reminder <appointment>`.
OUTCOME: completed
